method.filtering_summary: The live search pulled 2,280 postings; 1,659 were older than 7 days, 28 were reposts of listings over 30 days old, 190 were senior or excluded titles, 183 were not target roles, 142 failed Kenya eligibility, 2 were already applied to and 11 were duplicates. Himalayas (incomplete read), LinkedIn (429 rate limit) and ReliefWeb (timeout) failed in the automated search, and the automated Wellfound fetch is disabled by design. Browser passes (signed in, 23 Nov): Wellfound (983 results, about 100 cards read, 1 shortlisted), Fuzu (701 jobs; keyword searches: software developer 93, python 16, react 3, AI engineer 7, full stack 2; 2 kept) and the MyJobMag personalised feed (about 50 roles, 3 kept). Jobgether returned 510 roles and 210 fresh; none were shortlisted because the Africa-tagged Junior ACE and Junior AI Engineer listings are copies of one Revit/.NET or computer-vision post under many company names, and the rest were Europe-only. micro1 returned 65 roles; the new ones are GPU, CUDA and machine-learning research roles that don't fit his stack, so none were shortlisted.

stories.title: Sarvam releases open-weight Sarvam-105B-1711 for agents and Indian-language voice
stories.summary: The new open-weight 105B checkpoint averages 73.9 across eight conversational agent benchmarks (up from 42.6) at a blended $0.15 per million tokens, down from $0.44; the 65 GB NVFP4 version runs on a single workstation GPU, and BF16 weights are on Hugging Face for fine-tuning.
stories.why: A cheap open model with strong tool use that you can fine-tune yourself is a practical base for low-cost agent and voice projects.

stories.title: Google previews Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API for large tool libraries
stories.summary: With defer_loading set to true, the model sees only each tool's name and short description and loads a full schema when needed; server-side search, schema load and function call resolve in 1 API request, there is no separate fee, and Google advises static loading under 20 stable tools.
stories.why: If you wire agents to dozens of functions or MCP servers, this cuts the token cost of tool definitions, which is a common pain point.

stories.title: Google announces Agent Compute Engine, microVM sandboxes that keep credentials outside the agent
stories.summary: The managed service runs agents in isolated microVMs with checkpoint and resume, and an external Agent Gateway injects secrets so credentials never sit inside the sandbox; it is not yet available, pricing is unannounced, and Google targets a preview in the coming months.
stories.why: Sandboxing agents and keeping secrets out of them is becoming standard practice, and worth knowing for any agent work you pitch.

stories.title: Signal limits screenshots on mobile to block OS-level AI agents from reading chats
stories.summary: Signal's president Meredith Whittaker called operating systems that integrate agentic AI an 'existential threat' to its privacy guarantees; screenshot restrictions are added on Android and iOS, users can turn the setting off, and she admitted the fix is 'incomplete'.
stories.why: As you build agents that read screens and apps, expect apps and users to push back on that access, so design permissions in from the start.

stories.title: Kenyan startup funding falls to a six-year low, per this week's African tech roundup
stories.summary: Kenyan ventures raised US$201 million in the nine months to September 2026 versus US$744 million a year earlier (down 73%), and only 45 Kenyan startups raised US$100,000 or more (down 32%), according to Africa: The Big Deal figures reported by Business Daily.
stories.why: Tighter local funding means fewer and pickier startup hiring rounds, so lead with shipped, revenue-relevant work when you apply.

stories.title: Storspay expands B2B cross-border payroll to Kenya and five other African markets
stories.summary: The Canada-based platform now covers Nigeria, Kenya, Uganda, Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire and Benin, paying staff and suppliers in local currency to bank accounts and mobile money wallets; it advertises rates from 1% and commonly 2% on African corridors and has registered with FINTRAC.
stories.why: Cross-border payroll and payout APIs into Kenyan rails are a growing product area you could build for, and a possible employer type.

stories.title: Bending Spoons buys Mailchimp from Intuit for $3.68 billion
stories.summary: Intuit paid roughly $12 billion for Mailchimp in 2021 and is taking a loss; the deal is about 90% cash and 10% stock ($368 million in new Bending Spoons shares), and Intuit says it will sharpen its focus on AI tools for small businesses.
stories.why: It shows how AI pressure on SaaS is reshaping product companies, and Bending Spoons-style acquirers consolidate engineering, which affects hiring.

stories.title: Enphase cuts about 320 jobs, 12% of staff, as it scales AI and automation
stories.summary: In an SEC filing dated November 20, Enphase said it will reduce headcount by approximately 12% (about 320 employees), move certain functions to cost-efficient regions, and scale productivity through artificial intelligence and automation, with about $25 million to $28 million in restructuring charges.
stories.why: Another employer pairing cuts with offshoring and AI productivity, which can favour cost-efficient remote talent like you if you show AI-assisted delivery.

stories.title: Safaricom confirms a technical fault disrupting Ziidi logins and withdrawals
stories.summary: Safaricom said on Saturday 21 November that a technical hitch was affecting Ziidi, its M-PESA money market fund, with no restoration time or cause given; Ziidi's assets under management rose 82.9% to KSh23.36 billion at half-year, and new Chief Financial Services Officer Boniface Mungania took permanent charge on 1 November.
stories.why: A live example of reliability risk in M-PESA-linked products, relevant to the M-PESA and wallet systems you build and test.

stories.title: Safaricom rebuts viral Ksh10 M-PESA reversal scam claim, points to Hakikisha
stories.summary: Responding to a claim that fraudsters send small amounts like Ksh10 then reverse to drain a balance, Safaricom said reversal applies only to the amount sent or received; it says final status is communicated within two hours and urges use of Hakikisha, which shows the recipient's name before a payment.
stories.why: Fraud-proofing flows such as recipient confirmation and scoped reversals are core design points for any M-PESA integration.

stories.title: Top Kenyan banks ask CBK for a 12-month pause on new capital rules
stories.summary: Bank chief executives want CBK's prudential guidelines for systemically important banks, due 1 January 2027 with extra buffers of 0.5 to 2.5 percent of the loan book, delayed a year; private-sector credit growth hit 10.6 percent in September 2026 versus a 2.9 percent contraction in January.
stories.why: Bank capital rules and the 2027 election year shape lending and fintech partnerships, so they affect where Kenyan fintech hiring goes.
